_about: Allow-lists for test_qa_art_lint.gd (docs/art_bible.md sections 7 and 8). Both lists only ever shrink: qa lowers them when files get cleaner. Nobody adds to them; new code follows the rule.

art_free_behaviours._about: Bot behaviours that load game/procgen/ art classes or engine visual classes today (1 = allowed). Art checks belong in unit tests and the client smoke test, not the 8-bot loop; these move there over time. Any other behaviour, and the server, shared code and bot-test harness, may not.

palette._about: Colour literals per game/procgen/ file as of 2026-11-23 (palette.gd excluded). New colours go in palette.gd with a comment saying what they are for.
